summary: Verified tennis alt-spread fix end-to-end on mobile UI (390x844). Backend DB has 3 new tennis alt-spread picks for 2026-06-24 (Justina Mikulskytė +6.5, Andrea Lazaro Garcia +5.0, Oceane Dodin +5.5) — all reachable through GET /api/picks/today?sport=Tennis. Frontend renders all 3 as LockPickCards on the Locks tab under the Tennis sport chip with valid lock_scores (94, 93, 96) and American odds (-190, -195, -230). Deep-dive on the Oceane Dodin +5.5 Games (Alt) pick renders cleanly: LOCK SCORE, ProbabilityBreakdown (Expected Win 71.7%), MarketRank/Edge panel (+2%), Confidence (Very High), BOOK ODDS (-230), no JS page errors. Add-to-slip flow works: slip badge increments to 1, opening the BetSlipFab shows the exact label 'Oceane Dodin +5.5 Games (Alt)' (not a stale 'Spread' label). Fix is fully verified.

rca_of_issue: Fix RCA: _build_tennis_alt_picks() had a hard `if spread_outs and favored:` gate that silently skipped spread generation whenever h2h consensus couldn't resolve a favorite. Fix relaxed the gate so picks are built for both sides (home/away) when no favorite is known, leaving lock_score / edge filtering to decide which survive. Verified that 3 alt-spread picks now exist and render in UI.
